Method of Attack: Supply-chain attack using typosquatting to distribute malicious NPM modules containing obfuscated Javascript code designed to steal data from embedded forms including sign-in forms
Exfiltration of serialized form data to attacker-controlled domains
Attack Vector: Typosquatting via public NPM repository with names similar to popular legitimate packages
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious NPM modules exfiltrating data to attacker-controlled domains
